assumptions.spoilerAttackDamage: Transferred Warlord attack sample including explicit misses; small positive HP-censored finishers removed. Sample, varied ×0.8/1.0/1.3; not a measured spoiler damage distribution.
assumptions.spoilerSweep: Single target, ratio to attack median varied ×1/1.8/3, 17s hinted cooldown; not fitted to spoiler combat.
assumptions.mp: Base action costs use upper observed net MP; regen 0/4/8 MP per second, potion +500MP with 0/0.6/1.6sec overhead are sensitivity assumptions.
assumptions.groups: Provoke up to31 and Howl up to21 in these scenarios, based on observed examples; not universal server caps. Victory settlement of remaining neighbors after a finishing Whirlwind/Thunder Storm is compared with strict direct-kill-only mode; no such settlement is assumed after single-target Wild Sweep/basic attack.
assumptions.excluded: No PvP, bosses, captcha/server outages, death/HP optimization, loot prices, travel, respawn depletion, or buff/toggle alternatives. Buffs and existing equipment are held fixed.
assumptions.spoil: Solo success 0.45/0.55/0.75 are assumptions informed by old 50–60% observations, not a fitted current success rate. Festival100% only for eligible targets per native catalog. Unlearned Festival appears solely as an explicitly labelled upgrade scenario.
